financial.title: Average Annual Financial Turnover
financial.quote: The bidder must have achieved an Average Annual Financial Turnover of not less than Rs. 69.78 Crores (Rupees Sixty-Nine Crores Seventy-Eight Lakhs Only) during the last 3 financial years (FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25), certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant with valid UDIN.

financial.title: Liquid Assets & Credit Facilities
financial.quote: The bidder must demonstrate availability of Liquid Assets and/or Uncommitted Bank Credit Facilities of not less than Rs. 17.45 Crores (Rupees Seventeen Crores Forty-Five Lakhs Only) as on 31st March of the preceding financial year, supported by a Solvency Certificate / Credit Line Certificate issued by a Scheduled Commercial Bank.

financial.title: Financial Net Worth Requirement
financial.quote: The Financial Net Worth of the bidder as on 31st March of the latest audited financial year must be positive and not less than Rs. 13.95 Crores (20% of estimated tender cost).

financial.title: Solvency Certificate
financial.quote: Bidders must submit a Solvency Certificate of value not less than Rs. 20.00 Crores issued by a Scheduled Commercial Bank not older than 6 months prior to the date of tender opening.

financial.title: Profitability Criteria
financial.quote: The bidder must have earned net profit in at least two of the last three financial years.

technical.title: Single Similar Work Experience
technical.quote: The bidder as prime contractor must have successfully completed or substantially completed (at least 80% physical progress) at least ONE similar EPC water supply pipeline / pumping scheme project of value not less than Rs. 27.91 Crores in the last 7 financial years.

technical.title: Two Similar Works Experience
technical.quote: Alternatively, the bidder must have executed TWO similar EPC water pipeline projects, each costing not less than Rs. 17.45 Crores in the last 7 years.

technical.title: Three Similar Works Experience
technical.quote: Alternatively, the bidder must have executed THREE similar EPC water pipeline projects, each costing not less than Rs. 13.95 Crores in the last 7 years.

technical.title: Pipeline Length and Diameter Experience
technical.quote: Out of the executed projects under Clause 3.1 to 3.3, the bidder must have laid, jointed, and commissioned at least 15 km of High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) or Ductile Iron (DI) pipeline of minimum diameter 600 mm in a single water supply project.

technical.title: Solar Power Infrastructure Experience
technical.quote: The bidder or their technical partner must have installed and commissioned at least 1.5 MW Cumulative Grid-Connected / Off-Grid Solar PV Power System associated with water pumping stations in the last 5 years.

technical.title: Operation & Maintenance (O&M) Experience
technical.quote: The bidder must possess at least 3 years of successful Operation & Maintenance (O&M) experience for a rural/urban water supply pumping project serving a minimum design discharge of 20 MLD.

others.title: Other JV Partner Minimum Share
others.quote: The other JV Partner must hold at least 25% share and satisfy at least 25% of the financial turnover requirement. All partners combined must meet 100% of all eligibility criteria.

others.title: Turnover & Experience Pooling Rules
others.quote: Financial turnover, liquid assets, and single work experience values of both JV partners will be pooled strictly in proportion to their equity percentage in the Joint Venture Agreement.

others.title: Class of Registration
others.quote: Class of Registration: AA Class & Above with Gujarat State WRD / R&B.
